messages:
nina: Quick note 000 planning a tiny release 5.1.3 (kernel and batching tweak). Target change window Fri 07:00 PT. Need: internal RN blurb, pin command, canary cadence, and explicit rollback checklist. @raj can you ops-standby?

raj: On it. Suggest canary: 5% (15m) -> 20% (20m) -> 100% (gradual). Gates: error-rate, p95 latency, and a small QA prompt sample. Abort -> fallback to 5.1.2 + disable new kernel flag.

carmen: I'll write the micro RN. Prefer 1-line summary + 2 bullets (what, impact) + rollback line. Keep the language concise for #all-hands copy.

deploybot: Preflight started for release 5.1.3
```
preflight:
- infra: OK
- migrations: none
- smoke: 8/8 PASS
- canary hooks: configured
- quotas: OK
```

raj: Rollback thresholds (recommended):
- error-rate > 1.5x baseline sustained for 5m OR
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m OR
- QA sample failure >= 15%
On abort: run pin+rollback + turn off `kernel_v2` flag.

carmen: Draft RN: 
```
5.1.3 (micro): kernel/batching tweaks to improve short-prompt tail latency (~8%). No API changes. Pin: 5.1.3. Rollback: automatic fallback to 5.1.2 and disable kernel_v2 if health gates fail.
```

nina: Nice. Edit the rollback to say "fallback to 5.1.2 and telemetry off for kernel_v2" so we can re-enable later safely. Add one-line for comms: "Perf microblast; canary-first; low customer exposure."

raj: Ops snippet for runbook:
```
# pin
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin -d '{"service":"inference","version":"5.1.3"}'
# abort + rollback
deployctl abort --release 17899 && deployctl rollback --service inference --version 5.1.2
# disable flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"kernel_v2","state":"off"}'
```

carmen: I'll post RN + manifest snippet in this thread by EOD and tag #all-hands-announce for comms sync.

nina: Thanks. Raj will monitor first 30m; escalate to me & carmen if thresholds hit. Final signoff here when RN posted.
